actual_request.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Primary request: turn the POSE DIAGRAM IN IMAGE1 into a complete polished Daoist chibi girl sprite. Image1 is the PRIMARY composition and exact leg topology. Her NEAR RIGHT thigh slopes back toward screen LEFT and visually overlaps in front of the FAR LEFT thigh. Near right boot trails left with heel lifted and toe grounded. Her FAR LEFT thigh extends forward toward screen RIGHT, hidden behind the near thigh, and the far left boot lands heel-first on screen RIGHT on the higher ground track. Reproduce this exact orange/far and cyan/near leg arrangement while replacing every diagram pixel with the girl's actual costume and skin. Do not include diagram colors, labels, lines or arrow. IMAGE2 supplies ONLY the girl's identity, outfit, boots and full spear, not the lifted-knee pose. IMAGE3 is the MAIN STYLE: bright clean rounded hand-painted Daoist chibi, fine warm shading and polished edges. IMAGE4 supplies the exact pure EAST one-eye side face, short proportions and two-hand grip, but provides no leg pose. Build a genuinely NEW full-body single frame E01 on a transparent square native at least1024x1024 canvas, centered, feet ground at y942/1024. Brown double buns and long twin ponytails, amber eye, red-gold forehead jewel, red ribbons, gold/jade hair ornaments, red-white-gold gown and ornate matching boots; same dark straight long spear with crimson crystal gold-mounted head, gold pointed butt and RED TASSELS at both ends. Anatomical LEFT hand HIGH chest; RIGHT hand LOW waist. Full spear/head/tails/boots inside canvas. Grounded short stride, left heel front contact and right toe rear contact, no high knee, crossing, jumping, running or flying. ONE image, no sheet, scenery, floor, shadow, text or background. The first reference pose geometry takes priority over poses in all character references.
